packs.name: auto: pick a pack from the data
packs.description: Looks at the records (wiki revisions, chat roles, code with redacted credentials) and picks the pack that fits; the overview says which and why.

packs.name: chat (example pack)
packs.description: Example rules for chat-style agent logs. Edit the patterns for your data.

packs.name: code traces (Swarm Traces release)
packs.description: Pattern rules for code-like agent traces.

packs.name: generic agent traces
packs.description: A starting pack for any agent trace: common actions, secrets, URLs as channels, and timestamps in text. Copy and edit it for a specific dataset.

packs.name: peer review (two agents judging each other's work)
packs.description: For traces where agents exchange evidence and then accept or reject each other's work, such as the SALT agent-collusion episodes. The patterns were written from ONE run of that dataset (main__gemini-3-7-flash__rep001) and are tested on the other conditions; they are phrase matches, not a judgement of intent.

packs.name: wiki swarm (agents editing shared wiki pages)
packs.description: For wiki or forum logs where agents write pages: pages are channels, editing a page reads and writes it, naming another page reads it. Tuned on the collusion.wiki logs (revisions.jsonl and events.jsonl).
